enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Present Continuous para explicar situações ou consequências, apresenta vocabulário útil com traduções e exemplos práticos, além de explorar expressões idiomáticas e pronúncia de palavras específicas.

vocabulary.definition: Used to indicate the reason or cause of something.
examples: We missed the bus because of this.
She got late because of this.
The man is reading a book.
He is a very kind man.

vocabulary.definition: Plural of man; adult male humans.
examples: The men are working in the field.
These men are friends.

vocabulary.definition: Refers to the days from Monday to Friday.
examples: I work on weekdays.
The shop is open on weekdays.
This gadget is a novelty.
The novelty of the idea impressed everyone.

vocabulary.definition: The ability to assess and begin things independently.
examples: She showed great initiative in the project.
Taking initiative is important for success.

vocabulary.definition: A feeling of uncertainty or lack of conviction.
examples: I have no doubt about his honesty.
There’s some doubt about the results.

vocabulary.definition: Covered or saturated with water or another liquid.
examples: The grass is wet after the rain.
My shoes are wet.
I check my emails daily.
Daily exercise is good for health.

vocabulary.definition: Despite what has been said or done.
examples: It was raining; even so, she went for a walk.
He apologized, but even so, she was upset.

grammar.topic: Present Continuous for explanation or consequence
grammar.explanation: The Present Continuous is used to describe actions happening at the moment of speaking or ongoing actions. It can also be used to explain causes or consequences.
rules: Use negative sentences when necessary: Subject + is/are/am + not + verb-ing.
examples: Don't ask me to sit next to Noah. I'm avoiding contact with him.
I can't participate in the project. I'm finishing another campaign.
Please don't make so much noise. I’m studying. The baby is sleeping.
commonMistakes: Confusing Present Continuous with Simple Present.
Forgetting to use 'am', 'is', or 'are' before the verb in Present Continuous.

expressions.usage: Used to describe a sequence of events happening one after another.
examples: He won three games in a row.
She has been late three days in a row.

practiceQuestions.question: Use Present Continuous to explain: Why can’t you join the meeting?
practiceQuestions.answer: I’m preparing a presentation right now.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Present Continuous is used here to explain the reason for not being able to join the meeting.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: 'Estou estudando todos os dias.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: This sentence uses Present Continuous to describe an ongoing habit.

culturalNotes: In English-speaking cultures, people often use Present Continuous for immediate explanations or justifications in everyday conversation.
Using idiomatic expressions like 'in a row' can make speech sound more natural and fluent.
studyTips: Practice forming sentences using Present Continuous to describe your current actions.
Use flashcards to memorize vocabulary and their translations.
Listen to native speakers’ conversations or watch videos to understand how Present Continuous is used in real-life contexts.
originalExamples: Don't ask me to sit next to Noah. I'm avoiding contact with him. (Não me peça para sentar ao lado do Noah. Estou evitando contato com ele.)
I can't participate in the project. I'm finishing another campaign. (Não posso participar do projeto. Estou terminando outra campanha.)
Please don't make so much noise. I’m studying. The baby is sleeping. (Por favor, não faça tanto barulho. Estou estudando. O bebê está dormindo.)
I need to eat something soon. I’m eating every three hours. I’m getting hungry. (Preciso comer algo em breve. Estou comendo a cada três horas. Estou ficando com fome.)
I don't have anywhere to live now. I’m travelling all the time / around the world. (Eu não tenho onde morar agora. Estou viajando o tempo todo / pelo mundo.)
We need to go to the supermarket. I’m cooking the last piece of meat. (Precisamos ir ao supermercado. Estou cozinhando o último pedaço de carne.)
They don't need their car any more. They’re living near to the subway. (Eles não precisam mais do carro. Eles estão morando perto do metrô.)
Things are not so good at work. I’m selling below the target. (As coisas não estão tão boas no trabalho. Estou vendendo abaixo da meta.)
It isn't true what he said. He’s lying about his work. (Não é verdade o que ele disse. Ele está mentindo sobre o trabalho.)
We're going to get wet if we go out now. It’s raining now. (Vamos nos molhar se sairmos agora. Está chovendo agora.)

My husband and I are in contact with the orphanage. We’re talking with social worker. We’re looking for a child for adoption. (Meu marido e eu estamos em contato com o orfanato. Estamos conversando com um assistente social. Estamos procurando uma criança para adoção.)
I want to lose weight. I’m working on this. (Quero perder peso. Estou trabalhando nisso.)
